initial_eminence.title: Godric and Salazar trade knowledge
initial_eminence.description:
Against his mother's wishes, Salazar spends the majority of the summer of 986 studying with Godric. They aren't exactly friends, but they teach one another what they know. Salazar, having now invented many spells and having harnessed his parseltongue and arithmancy skills, had much to teach Gryffindor about the magical world. Godric had a more foundational grasp of concepts that Salazar had not yet encountered.

Godric spent the summer in London exclusively to be close to Salazar for the purposes of their mutual study.

initial_eminence.title: Godric and Salazar study together
initial_eminence.description:
Godric and Slytherin spend another summer studying together, inventing spells and documenting magical concepts. They aren't exactly friends, they just recognize the value the other brings. Godric remains quite skeptical of slytherin's moral compass and his intentions.

Godric spends an entire summer living in London to study with Salazar

initial_eminence.title: Godric and Salazar study together
initial_eminence.description: Throughout the entire year, Godric and Salazar regularly study together, continuing to harness their skills.

initial_eminence.title: Salazar and Godric continue their study
Godric and Salazar study intensely
initial_eminence.description: Throughout the first part of the year, Godric and Salazar study nearly daily together and rapidly improve their skills.

initial_eminence.title: Rowena, Godric and Salazar travel together
initial_eminence.description: The three future founders begin to travel the British Isles together seeking a potential site for their school. The had no intention of bringing on another founder. However, they were charmed and impressed by Helga Hufflepuff when they met her in the Orkneys. She suggested the area that eventually became the home of Hogwarts. During their time traveling together, they continued to share their mutually beneficial skillsets with one another.

initial_eminence.title: Founders co-study group
initial_eminence.description: A few years after the opening of Hogwarts, the founders develop a co-study group to learn from one another and share their research helping each grow together.

initial_eminence.description: Wulfstan didn't know much magic, but he taught Godric all he did know.

initial_eminence.title: Battle of Tempsford
initial_eminence.description: Despite being a child, he joins the fight against the Norsemen raiders at the Battle of Tempsford. He is decisive in ensuring the victory for Edward the Elder.

initial_eminence.title: Battle of Brunanburh
initial_eminence.description: Athelstan personally requested Godric join him, knowing of his past deeds. Godric supported the vision of a unified England and joined the fight, proving quite helpful in the unification of England.

initial_eminence.title: Discovers Diagon Alley
initial_eminence.description: Through felt-sense, he develops an ability to detect traces of magic. This leads him to explore London eventually independently discovering Diagon Alley.

initial_eminence.title: Salazar sneaks into Diagon Alley
initial_eminence.description: Through a combination of concealment charms, arithmancy, and perception, Slytherin discerns how to enter Diagon Alley and sneaks inside. Salazar's mother did not want him to interact with wizarding folk. However, he sneaks into Diagon Alley anyway. Gryffindor notices him do this and immediately recognizes his talents. The magical commuinity welcomes Salazar, but he remains wary of others.

initial_eminence.title: Godric recruits Ravenclaw
initial_eminence.description: Rowena and Godric were friends from Wessex for years. Godric always respected Rowena and was excited to ask her to join the mission to found Hogwarts.

people.narrative:
Emeric the Evil is born in Saxony to wealthy and loving muggle parents. They realize his magical gift and realize he needs support in developing it. They learn of Hogwarts and arrange to ensure he can attend the school. 

Slytherin hated him because of his muggleborn status. So after a minor incident with other students, Slytherin amplified evidence to paint Emeric as dangerous and untrustworthy. Slytherin assured he would be expelled. Emeric was furious at Slytherin for his sabotage of his future, bitter at the other staff for failing to protect him, and became angry at all magical folk, launching his mission to seek power, his drive to kill wizards, and his search for the elder wand.

entries.note:
The Peverell family descended from a man named Pever, who had numerous children. Pever likely got his name from living near the Pever river in Chesire in Mercia. 

Locals in the West Country referred to the massive family over time as "all the Pever's kin" which was shortened to "all the Pever's" and eventually "Pever's all" -- a nickname that gradually contracted into Peverell. By the late ninth century, the family was widely known by that name, making Antioch, Cadmus, and Ignotus the first generation to bear it as a hereditary family designation.

people.narrative: One of the three brothers.

initial_eminence.title: Begins inventing dark magic & defensive spells
Godric and Salazar trade knowledge
initial_eminence.description:
Against his mother's wishes, Salazar spends the majority of the summer of 986 studying with Godric. They aren't exactly friends, but they teach one another what they know. Salazar, having now invented many spells and having harnessed his parseltongue and arithmancy skills, had much to teach Gryffindor about the magical world. Godric had a more foundational grasp of concepts that Salazar had not yet encountered.

Godric spent the summer in London exclusively to be close to Salazar for the purposes of their mutual study.

initial_eminence.title: Godric and Salazar study together
initial_eminence.description:
Godric and Slytherin spend another summer studying together, inventing spells and documenting magical concepts. They aren't exactly friends, they just recognize the value the other brings. Godric remains quite skeptical of slytherin's moral compass and his intentions.

Godric spends an entire summer living in London to study with Salazar

initial_eminence.description: Throughout the first part of the year, Godric and Salazar study nearly daily together and rapidly improve their skills.

initial_eminence.title: Rowena, Godric and Salazar travel together
initial_eminence.description: The three future founders begin to travel the British Isles together seeking a potential site for their school. The had no intention of bringing on another founder. However, they were charmed and impressed by Helga Hufflepuff when they met her in the Orkneys. She suggested the area that eventually became the home of Hogwarts. During their time traveling together, they continued to share their mutually beneficial skillsets with one another.

During their time traveling together, they continued to share their mutually beneficial skillsets with one another.

organizations.name: Hogwarts
organizations.notes:
Hogwarts was founded in part as a response to regular viking invasions in the mid to late 10th century. Wizarding magic tended to be too fragmented and imprecise to reliably be used to defend towns from raids. The founders saw the need to educate the public in magical prowess so that more mages were available to defend against raids. For a time, this worked. Vikings were relatively stymied. 

This too is why Slytherin was included as a founder. His skill was seen as valuable even if his morals questionable. 

Emerick the Evil learned from Slytherin and eventually turned on the wizarding population killing many important figures and significantly weakening wizarding defenses. Armand Malfoy and William the Conquerer then capitalized on the moment to invade in 1066.

International Confederation of Wizards
organizations.notes:
Nations decide whether they will send an ambassador, representative, a delegate, emissary or envoy

Ambassadors are allowed to decide on their own judgement what is best for their country. They are trusted to represent their government's interests.

Representatives can operate on their own judgement but are expected to represent the populace of the nation.

Delegates have to check with their leadership on final decision making and are expected to represent the country's government. 

Emmisary can use their own judgement in attempting to represent their governments interests in negotiations but all final decisions are subject to ratification by their government. 

Envoy has limited decision-making authority in negotiations tending to have to communicate with their government heavily during negotiations for ongoing approval and guidance.

events.title: Emeric expelled from Hogwarts
events.description: After a minor incident with other students, Slytherin amplified evidence to paint Emeric as dangerous and untrustworthy. Slytherin assured he would be expelled. Emeric was furious at Slytherin for his sabotage of his future, bitter at the other staff for failing to protect him, and became angry at all magical folk, launching his mission to seek power, his drive to kill wizards, and his search for the elder wand.

events.title: Seeks knowledge

events.title: Mastery of Grimoires

events.title: Discovers 2nd Elder Wand Clue

events.title: First usage of the wand for murder
events.description:
When Emeric first uses the Elder Wand for murder, he unwittingly, begins the process which eventually killed the tree that bore the wand itself. 

The tree could feel every spell being cast with its former branches and the connection to the wand remained until the tree's final days. Being used for such evil purposes led to a rotting of the tree of origin ultimately ensuring its death. The source of the Elder Wand was lost forever.

events.title: Emeric Kills Salazar Slytherin
events.description:
Emeric utilizes his, so far undetected, access to Hogwarts to gain access to Slytherin's storage. He discovers basilisk venom and uses it to poison Salazar's food. Salazar had sensed some nefarious magic but was ultimately blinded by his underestimation of a muggleborn, Emeric, and his familiarity with the basilisk. He had been around his basilisk for so many years that he didn't view it as odd to sense basilisk venom in his presence. Emeric announced after the event that he was Slytherin's murderer.

This ignites in Egbert the Egregious a striving for vengence. Most of the public was unaware that Egbert killed Slytherin.

events.title: Killing spree
events.description: His vengence didn't settle the pain of losing his mentor. He goes on a grief-striken muggle killing spree.
